categories.title: Emergency & Safety Helplines
categories.blurb: All-in-one emergency response, women and child safety, and cybercrime reporting.

entries.name: National Emergency Number (ERSS)
entries.desc: Single emergency number for police, fire and medical help across India.

entries.name: Cyber Crime Helpline
entries.desc: Report online fraud and cybercrime. Call within the golden hour for the best chance of stopping a transaction.

entries.name: Women Helpline
entries.desc: 24x7 helpline for women facing violence, harassment or any distress.

entries.name: National Commission for Women
entries.desc: Complaints of atrocities against women and safeguarding of women's rights.

entries.name: CHILDLINE (Ministry of WCD)
entries.desc: Free, 24x7 phone outreach service for children in need of care and protection.

entries.name: Anti-Human Trafficking Helpline
entries.desc: Ministry of Home Affairs helpline for reporting trafficking and seeking rescue assistance.

entries.name: National Human Rights Commission
entries.desc: Complaints of human rights violations by public servants.

entries.name: Terrorism / Security Threat (NSCS)
entries.desc: Report information related to terrorism and security threats.

categories.title: Free Legal Aid & Advice
categories.blurb: Government-backed free legal advice, counselling and representation for eligible citizens.

entries.name: NALSA Helpline
entries.desc: National Legal Services Authority — free legal aid to women, children, SC/ST, persons with disability, senior citizens and others. 'Tele Law' connects you to a panel lawyer.

entries.name: Tele-Law (Dept. of Justice)
entries.desc: Free legal advice through Common Service Centres and a mobile app. Advice through video/tele consultation with panel lawyers.

entries.name: DALSA / DLSA
entries.desc: District Legal Services Authorities run free legal aid clinics in every district under the district court.

entries.name: DoJ Access to Justice
entries.desc: Department of Justice, Ministry of Law & Justice — access to justice and NRHM justice initiatives.

entries.name: Supreme Court Legal Aid Committee
entries.desc: Free legal aid for eligible litigants in the Supreme Court.

categories.title: Courts & Judiciary
categories.blurb: Case status, e-filing, cause lists, judgments and e-courts services of the Indian judiciary.

entries.name: Supreme Court of India
entries.desc: Case status, cause lists, judgments, e-filing and display board of the apex court.

entries.name: eCourts Services
entries.desc: Unified portal for case status, cause lists, orders and judgments of all district courts and High Courts.

entries.name: eFiling (eCourts)
entries.desc: File cases and pay court fees online in enrolled courts.

entries.name: National Judicial Data Grid
entries.desc: Data on pendency and disposal of cases across all courts in India.

entries.name: High Courts of India
entries.desc: Directory of all 25 High Courts with case status and cause lists.

entries.name: District Courts of India
entries.desc: Directory of district court websites across states and UTs.

entries.name: Supreme Court & High Court Judgments
entries.desc: Free judgments information system of the e-Committee of the Supreme Court.

entries.name: Indian Courts (NIC)
entries.desc: Portal of the Indian judiciary with links to courts, tribunals and legal services.

categories.title: Ministries, Law & Justice
categories.blurb: Core government departments that make, codify and administer the law.

entries.name: Ministry of Law & Justice
entries.desc: Parent ministry of the Legislative, Legal Affairs and Justice departments.

entries.name: Department of Legal Affairs
entries.desc: Legal advice to Government of India, appointment of law officers, litigation on behalf of the Union.

entries.name: Department of Justice
entries.desc: Court infrastructure, legal aid, access to justice, Tele-Law and Nyaya Vikas schemes.

entries.name: Legislative Department
entries.desc: Drafting of central legislation and codification and printing of laws.

entries.name: Ministry of Home Affairs
entries.desc: Police, internal security, emergency support schemes including emergency number 112.

entries.name: Ministry of External Affairs (Consular)
entries.desc: Help for Indians abroad in legal distress, arrests and consular assistance (MADAD portal).

categories.title: Law Libraries & Codes
categories.blurb: Read the Constitution, central and state Acts, rules and notifications — free and authentic.

entries.name: Constitution of India
entries.desc: Official text of the Constitution with latest amendments, in English and Hindi.

entries.name: India Code
entries.desc: Digital repository of all central and state Acts, rules, regulations and notifications.

entries.name: Digital Sansad
entries.desc: Bills, debates and questions of Parliament — Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha.

entries.name: India.gov.in — Law & Justice
entries.desc: National portal of India's law and justice section with links to all government legal resources.

categories.title: Tribunals & Quasi-Judicial Bodies
categories.blurb: Specialised adjudication bodies for service, company, consumer, tax and other matters.

entries.name: Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT)
entries.desc: Disputes on recruitment and service conditions of central government employees.

entries.name: National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT)
entries.desc: Corporate law adjudication, insolvency and company disputes.

entries.name: National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT)
entries.desc: Appeals against orders of NCLT, Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board and Competition Commission of India.

entries.name: National Green Tribunal (NGT)
entries.desc: Environmental protection and conservation of forests and natural resources.

entries.name: Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT)
entries.desc: Appeals under direct tax laws.

entries.name: Armed Forces Tribunal (AFT)
entries.desc: Service matters and appeals of armed forces personnel.

entries.name: Debts Recovery Tribunal (DRT)
entries.desc: Recovery of debts due to banks and financial institutions.

entries.name: National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC)
entries.desc: Consumer disputes and appeals; e-Daakhil portal for online consumer complaints.

entries.name: e-Daakhil
entries.desc: File consumer commission and other cases online and track them.

categories.title: Regulators & Commissions
categories.blurb: Statutory regulators for elections, human rights, information, legal profession and more.

entries.name: Election Commission of India
entries.desc: Elections, voter registration and model code of conduct; voter helpline 1950.

entries.name: National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)
entries.desc: Human rights violations complaints and human rights literacy.

entries.name: Central Information Commission (CIC)
entries.desc: Second appellate authority under the Right to Information Act, 2005.

entries.name: Central Vigilance Commission (CVC)
entries.desc: Complaints against central government employees; whistle-blower protection.

entries.name: Bar Council of India (BCI)
entries.desc: Regulates legal practice and legal education; advocate enrolment and discipline.

entries.name: Advocates-on-Record & Law Officers
entries.desc: Supreme Court Bar and advocate-related services of the apex court.

entries.name: National Commission for Minorities
entries.desc: Safeguards and complaints related to minority communities.

entries.name: National Commission for Scheduled Castes
entries.desc: Investigates safeguards for Scheduled Castes and handles complaints.

entries.name: National Commission for Scheduled Tribes
entries.desc: Investigates safeguards for Scheduled Tribes and handles complaints.

entries.name: Chief Vigilance Officers (CVC Complaints)
entries.desc: Lodge vigilance complaints online against central government organisations.

entries.name: Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)
entries.desc: Anti-corruption and special crimes complaints and general information.

entries.name: National Investigation Agency (NIA)
entries.desc: Investigation of terrorism-related offences; report information to counter-terrorism agencies.

entries.name: NARCIS — Narcotics Control Bureau
entries.desc: Report drug trafficking and Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances related information.

entries.name: Report Online Child Sexual Abuse

entries.name: Lost & Found / CCTV (Delhi Police)
entries.desc: Example citizen services portal of a metro police — check your state police website for similar services.
